BR-001.title: Request missing information first
BR-001.condition: The feedback cannot be linked to a delivery item or does not describe the desired change.
BR-001.outcome: Retain feedback and attachments, identify a concrete gap, and do not infer effort.

BR-002.title: Keep evidence for small changes
BR-002.condition: The change adds no scope and changes no delivery milestone, and the designer has recorded the basis.
BR-002.outcome: The designer may handle it directly, retaining the assessment and outcome for the lead.

BR-003.title: A lead confirms new commitments
BR-003.condition: The request adds scope or cost, or affects a delivery milestone.
BR-003.outcome: Request lead confirmation; do not communicate a committed date until an explicit decision is saved.
BR-003.notes: Aligned with F-002 / F-004 and the decision branches in P-001; this is a synthetic review decision.

BR-004.title: Return is different from decline
BR-004.condition: The lead needs more evidence before deciding.
BR-004.outcome: Retain the request, explain what is missing, and allow revision and resubmission.
BR-004.notes: Aligned with F-002 / F-004 and the decision branches in P-001; this is a synthetic review decision.

BR-005.title: Explain what a deferral awaits
BR-005.condition: The lead chooses to defer the request.
BR-005.outcome: State the outstanding business decision and follow-up condition; do not present a deferral as a decline.
BR-005.notes: Aligned with F-002 / F-004 and the decision branches in P-001; this is a synthetic review decision.

BR-006.title: Separate saving from delivery
BR-006.condition: A decision is saved but the external notification service has not confirmed delivery.
BR-006.outcome: Keep the decision valid, show failed delivery and allow retry without duplicating the decision.

BR-007.title: Explicitly adopt an AI draft
BR-007.condition: The assistant returns an impact explanation that has not been adopted.
BR-007.outcome: Show an editable draft only; do not overwrite human explanations or change the decision status.

BR-008.title: Review concurrent updates
BR-008.condition: Another member saves a newer version of the same decision during review.
BR-008.outcome: Retain current input, show the conflict and latest content, and allow retry after review.
